counterfactuals.note: A flip found only at a large perturbation of the expert's own score is not boundary sensitivity; the cut is declared in advance at the listed steps.

candidates.description: Credit a BYPASS only when at least one substitute is itself delivering.
candidates.complexity: O(substitutes) per action; no new traversal.
candidates.determinismImpact: None. Same integer arithmetic, same ordering rule.
candidates.contractImpact: None. No new signal, no new field, no schema change.
candidates.arbiterImpact: None. The arbiter consumes a recommendation and a signal block, both unchanged in shape.

candidates.description: Align the expert operational threshold with the world availability threshold.
candidates.blastRadius: One constant. Note it was set deliberately different in Stage 2L.13.

candidates.description: Replace the local blocked test with a fixed-point delivery resolution over dependency, support, inhibition and substitution.
candidates.complexity: O(entities * relations) per case, bounded by entity count passes.
candidates.determinismImpact: None if the iteration bound and ordering are fixed, as in the diagnostic here.
candidates.contractImpact: None required; existing signals keep their meaning.
candidates.blastRadius: The blocked predicate and everything derived from it: addressesTarget, remainingBlockers, alreadyProtected.

candidates.description: Charge the conflict penalty an intervention would activate.
Include amplification conferred by delivering amplifiers in bearer value.
Credit exposure removed downstream when a non-delivering protector is restored.

topCandidate.determinismImpact: None. Same integer arithmetic, same ordering rule.
topCandidate.contractImpact: None. No new signal, no new field, no schema change.
topCandidate.arbiterImpact: None. The arbiter consumes a recommendation and a signal block, both unchanged in shape.

secondCandidate.description: Align the expert operational threshold with the world availability threshold.
secondCandidate.blastRadius: One constant. Note it was set deliberately different in Stage 2L.13.

allMechanismsProbe.describes: Every probe together. An upper bound on this probe family, not a proposed expert.

remediation.note: Coverage is measured by re-ranking the frozen expert's own decomposition with one additive delta. A probe is evidence that a mechanism matters, not a proposed implementation: the breaks column shows each probe also costs correct cases, so a real remediation must be more surgical than the probe.

feasibility.estimatedRemediableErrorShareMeaning: Share of residual errors whose dominant class is targeted by at least one candidate mechanism. An upper bound on scope, NOT a predicted fix rate.
feasibility.caveat: Raw accuracy is not delegation precision. Stage 2L.14 and 2L.15 both showed a supported region at 0.99 is a much stronger requirement than an accuracy gain, and nothing here certifies future performance.

interpretation.measuredRootCause: SUBSTITUTE_MISVALUATION is the dominant class at 41.8682% of residual errors by precedence and 41.8682% by any-label prevalence. A bounded probe targeting it improves accuracy, so it is remediable rather than intrinsic.

portabilityNote: Stage 2L.10 through 2L.15 remain DIGEST_PRODUCED_SINGLE_PLATFORM. Stage 2L.16 does not change that.
